en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a tall, modernist water tower with a unique architectural design. The tower has a round body, topped with a smaller cylindrical section which has large clocks on four sides. There are structural supports and small windows around the main structure. At the bottom, there are a few people, a car and utility poles, indicating a mid-20th century time period. The sky is partly cloudy and the landscape is open and slightly rocky. Text in a Scandinavian-style script is present at the bottom left.
